notes:
Stalled after discovery — contact dropped after requirements handoff and security exchange. Quick bullets and timeline:

- Discovery (5/10 - 7/18): collected detailed security and latency requirements. Key asks: HSM-backed KMS, FIPS certs, audit log retention 7 years, SSO SAML + SCIM, ability to run inference in customer-controlled VPC with private control plane.
- Performance targets: embeddings throughput 1k qps (batched), reranking latency p95 < 300ms for 1-5k doc sets, chat-style query latency p95 < 500ms with prefix cache.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to cut token cost 30% vs current provider; open to Dedicated reserved capacity if lifecycle ROI demonstrated.
- Timeline / touches:
  - 2024-05-12: initial discovery (Fireflies ff_20240512_veridian_discovery). Participants: Head of Engineering (K. Singh), CISO (M. Ortega), ML Platform lead.
  - 2024-05-25: architecture review: SE (Liam) shared VPC topology and onboarding checklist.

  - 2024-06-21: follow-up from security: asked for HSM vendor compatibility matrix + FIPS compliance details.
  - 2024-07-10: SE proposed 3-week Private pilot scope and Dedicated low-touch pilot as an alternative.

- Current assessment: Account likely stalled. Root causes: complex security gating (HSM + long retention), internal champion (Head of Eng) moved to different program in July, procurement cited hiring/budget freeze. Competitive risk: active POC with Google Vertex and some price-led talks with incumbent.
